name: nutrition-clinic
description: عيادة التغذية — patient-management platform for a dietitian's clinic

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @clinic/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm:dev -w @clinic/shared" "npm:dev -w @clinic/server" "npm:dev -w @clinic/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clinic/shared && npm run build -w @clinic/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clinic/shared && npm run typecheck -w @clinic/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @clinic/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
